matches.note: Rayne Young choked Big Weaze with the chain, hit the finisher "Game's Over," and dragged him to the final turnbuckle for the win.
Silveroak hit GBH with a chair as GBH landed a low blow; the referee called for a double disqualification.

matches.stipulation: Innercity Television Championship and Young Guns Championship unification match
matches.note: Paroxysm countered a superkick attempt into a cradle piledriver for the pin, retaining the Innercity title and winning the Young Guns title.
Jeremy Diaz pinned Viper with the finisher "Roll Out."

matches.stipulation: Number-one contendership to the Barrie District Championship
matches.note: Derek Matthews hit a Tombstone piledriver and a finishing sequence called "Legendary" for the pin.
A hardcore-rules three-way with no count-out or disqualification; Dan Benson hit the finisher "The Shocker" on Morpheus for the pin to become the new champion.

matches.stipulation: Legacy Championship, Legacy Rules grudge match
matches.note: Spike countered with his own finisher, "The Impaler," but Wolf kicked out and retained with "Wolf's Bite."
Both men kicked out of their own finishers; the referee's ten-count ran out on both men and the match was ruled a draw. Ryan Burns retained.

matches.stipulation: #18 entry in the Bunkhouse Brawl (weapons, elimination match)

eliminations.note: Powerbombed to the outside through an open table.
Hit with a steel door, then thrown out by Matt Hallowell and Dax Clark together.
Hit with the finisher "FullStop" and rolled to the outside.
Beaten down with a trash can and a Singapore cane until he fell from the ring apron to the floor.
